# CodeBuild

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/codebuild@v1.78.4` · last audited 2026-10-09 (`d522d763f`)

### Known gaps

- Docker engine git sources (GITHUB/GITHUB_ENTERPRISE/BITBUCKET/GITLAB/GITLAB_SELF_MANAGED): cloned with the host git CLI (not inside the build container), so git must be installed on the emulator host; file:// locations are rejected unless EngineConfig.AllowFileGitSources is set (no CLI flag yet); credentials resolve by serverType only (the project source `auth` block and per-project OAuth connections are ignored); PR refs map pr/N to GitHub refs/pull, GitLab refs/merge-requests and Bitbucket Server refs/pull-requests (Bitbucket Cloud exposes no PR refs); gitCloneDepth 0 means a full clone; buildStatusConfig/reportBuildStatus status reporting back to the Git host is not done.
- Docker engine logs stream line by line only when the container runtime implements container.StreamExecer (DockerRuntime does); any other EngineRuntime falls back to buffered per-script output.
- Docker engine reports: LCOV INFO is not parsed (the buildspec file-format list documents only CLOVERXML, COBERTURAXML, JACOCOXML and SIMPLECOV for coverage, so there is no accepted token); exportConfig S3 raw-data export is not modelled.
- Docker engine cache: cache.key (with $VAR and $(codebuild-hash-files ...) templating), fallback-keys (prefix match, newest local entry or lexically last S3 key; first five used) and action are honoured, and cacheNamespace (projects sharing a namespace share one local/S3 cache scope) are honoured, but keyed entries are never evicted. Without a key one archive per project is used (S3: <prefix>/<project>/cache.tar.gz). Absolute cache paths archive the whole directory before the first glob character (e.g. /root/.m2/**/* caches /root/.m2). Caches are saved only when no phase failed; local caches live under EngineConfig.CacheDir with no eviction; LOCAL_DOCKER_LAYER_CACHE only mounts /var/lib/docker for privileged-mode builds; LOCAL_SOURCE_CACHE applies to git sources only.
- Docker engine batch builds: child builds run through the engine, but BuildBatchConfig.CombineArtifacts and BatchReportMode remain config-only: the CodeBuild batch-build, batch buildspec and create-project pages (verified 2026-11-05) say only that artifacts are combined "into a single location" and give no layout, so merging is unverified and not emulated; BatchReportMode only affects Git-host commit statuses, which no emulator reports; batch-level reports/artifacts are not aggregated.
- Docker engine: proxy is parsed-and-ignored (structural: no explicit proxy server exists to route upload-artifacts/logs through); runtime-versions only logs the selection (documented warning on non-standard images, "Selecting runtime" on aws/codebuild images) and installs nothing because curated images map onto EngineConfig.DefaultImage; the buildspec reference and Available runtimes pages (verified 2026-11-05) document no error for an unsupported runtime version, only that conflicting runtimes (android+java) fail the build, so neither is emulated; artifacts.name is evaluated with the shell command language ($VAR, $(cmd)) in the build container before upload; exported-variables are returned on Build.exportedEnvironmentVariables and surface as CodePipeline output variables under the action namespace; an exported name unset at the end of the build is skipped silently (real failure behaviour unverified); env.shell powershell.exe/cmd.exe are accepted and ignored on Linux containers; run-as needs the user to exist in the image (su, chmod a+rwX on the workspace); AWS_ENDPOINT_URL/credentials are injected only when the app wires the endpoint (CLI port set) and STS trust for codebuild.amazonaws.com must allow the service role; service-specific AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_* are deliberately not set because current SDKs and the CLI honour AWS_ENDPOINT_URL (docs source: AWS CodeBuild buildspec reference; endpoint injection is a LocalStack-compatible convenience, SDKs honour AWS_ENDPOINT_URL).

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- BuildBatchConfig.CombineArtifacts and BatchReportMode are round-tripped config only: no artifact store to merge into and no Git host to report status to.
- Default (stub) engine mode runs no build commands, so reports/test cases/coverage are only produced in docker engine mode.

### Deferred

- Report-content ingestion (DescribeCodeCoverages/DescribeTestCases/GetReportGroupTrend real data) — see structural_gaps above for why this is a substantially larger feature (build artifact parsing), not a quick fix.
